caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of an ornate, metallic fireplace andiron with a decorative finial top, presented in a three-quarter perspective view. The andiron features a tall, urn-shaped finial with a series of turned sections, all colored in gradients of yellow-green, suggesting a brass or similar metal material. Below the finial, the main body transitions into a curved, horizontal brace that connects to a vertical back support adorned with openwork scroll and leaf patterns. The andiron stands on three curved legs, each terminating in a ball-shaped foot, with the two front legs curving outward and the back leg remaining straight and slender. To the upper left of the main illustration is a smaller, linear scale drawing showing a side profile of the andiron, accompanied by a horizontal ruler marked in inches. The names "JAMES O’MARA" and “COPIED BY HANS KORSCH” are inscribed along the bottom edge of the drawing. The background consists of an uncolored, plain page.
title: Andiron
